title: Robot restaurant
summary: Robots cook and serve food to cut labour costs.
whyTempting: Labour is a restaurant's biggest cost and it's hard to hire.
whyItFails: Hardware cost. Robots are expensive and break down. Limited menus. Automation forces narrow, rigid menus. Novelty isn't loyalty. Customers return for food, not robots.
whatWouldChange: Cheaper general-purpose robotics; automating back-of-house tasks first.

attempts.notes: Robot-made pizza baked in vans en route; quality complaints, robotics teams laid off in 2020.
Automated quinoa-bowl restaurants with kiosks and pickup cubbies; now sells restaurant automation tech.

reasons.detail: Hardware cost: Robots are expensive and break down.
Limited menus: Automation forces narrow, rigid menus.
Novelty isn't loyalty: Customers return for food, not robots.
